title: Vibe Video
type: Video editor for iPhone, iPad and Mac
description: A native video editor for cutting footage, working with audio and preparing videos for publication. Multitrack editing, effects and export are available in one application.
audience: Video creators, bloggers and content teams.
features: Multitrack timeline with trimming, splitting and layer ordering
Chroma key, background removal and person masks
Text, stickers, transitions and downloadable video packs
Voice-over and camera recording directly into a project
4K H.264 and 8K HEVC export with social format presets

title: Again Cleaner
type: Disk analysis and cleanup for macOS
description: See what occupies your Mac’s storage, find caches and temporary files, and choose what to remove. Dedicated tools cover development build artifacts and large files.
audience: Mac users and developers who want control over their storage.
features: Storage overview and Smart Scan results
Application caches, browser caches and temporary data
Detection of project dependencies and build artifacts
File selection before cleanup, with Trash used by default
Progress feedback and protection against repeated cleanup actions

title: LeadWise
description: A shared workspace for education providers, covering courses, study groups, timetables, lesson materials and homework. Administrators, teachers and students have dedicated workflows.
audience: Online schools and supplementary education centres.
features: Students, study groups and lesson management
Courses, lesson materials and content previews
Timetables with access to group management
Homework with text, attachments and teacher feedback
Custom branding for the learning platform

title: CodeClass / Kvantastika
type: ERP for a network of education centres
description: Development of an ERP that connects schools and franchise operations: students, groups, scheduling, payments and teaching. Financial transactions are linked to lesson access and learning history.
audience: School networks, franchise operators, administrators and teachers.
features: Students, groups and paid lesson balances
Lesson transfers, withdrawals and remaining lesson control
Invoices, payments, refunds and fiscal service integrations
Teacher availability, scheduling and substitute selection
School separation, access roles and event logs
note: Client system. Screens containing personal or payment information are not published.

title: Technology Generation
description: An education platform for Russia’s OGE school exams. It connects practice questions, webinars and student results, with tools for teachers to import and review learning materials.
audience: School students, teachers and exam preparation providers.
features: Questions organised by subject and topic, with answers and hints
Learning material imports with error reports

title: SkillUp
description: Online courses combining learning materials and practical assignments. Programming exercises run submitted code in an isolated environment.
audience: Students, course authors and education providers.
features: Learning content and course access management

title: Scheduler
description: A dedicated scheduling service with its own API and web interface. Designed to integrate with an education ERP, with a separate adaptation for LeadWise.
audience: Schools and education centres that need a dedicated planning service.
features: Scheduling through a web interface and API
API gateway and background task processing

title: Accounting Tools
description: A service for managing organisations, operation registers and fiscal receipt processing. Teams can prepare data, check duplicate rows and track receipt submission results.
audience: Accounting teams and companies processing batches of financial operations.
features: Organisation accounts and cash register management
Dry runs to review entries and amounts
ATOL Online integration and fiscalisation status tracking
note: Registers containing company financial data are not published.

title: Yoozuu
description: A platform for articles, discussions and sharing expertise. Includes publishing tools, topic sections and moderation, with layouts for desktop and mobile.
audience: Authors, professional communities and readers.
features: Publication feeds, topic sections and author profiles
Controls against registration abuse and spam
Light and dark themes with responsive layouts

title: PRobot
description: A workspace for marketing and PR: prepare content, connect channels and process publishing tasks in the background. AI assists with drafts while integrations connect distribution channels.
audience: Content teams, marketers and PR professionals.
features: Publishing platform catalogue and connected channels
Collection of materials and publication relationships
note: Publishing availability depends on the connected account and the target platform’s API.

title: Misa
type: Voice AI assistant with business integrations
description: An assistant with voice conversations, memory and tools for working with business information. A web client with a VRM character connects to speech services and Bitrix24.
audience: Teams that need an assistant for communication and information workflows.
features: Voice conversations with speech recognition and synthesis
Web client with an animated VRM character
Memory and search across accumulated context
Attachment processing and contextual information extraction
Direct links to created tasks in replies

title: Platinum OS One
type: Linux platform and image build system
description: A Linux platform with its own graphical shell and a shared build system for different devices. Hardware support is separated from build logic, and the interface adapts to the device.
audience: Device makers and developers of mobile and embedded systems.
features: Qt/QML shell with applications and a home screen
Bootable image builds through a Rust pipeline
Separate board profiles and hardware support packages
Ethernet, Wi-Fi and network connection management

title: Platinum Browser
description: A browser built on Chromium Embedded Framework with a custom interface. Tab groups act as separate workspaces with independent data and sessions.
audience: People working with multiple accounts and separate browsing contexts.
features: Tab groups with independent browser contexts
Protected groups with a password and recovery key — in development
Group locking and hidden locked tabs — in development
Data cleanup settings with time range selection
Custom browser interface built with CEF and C++
note: Protected groups and their locking workflows are under development.

Animations, audio and effects driven by gameplay events

title: Rush Messenger
type: Messenger with mobile and desktop clients
description: A communication platform with direct messages, groups, channels and calls. Native mobile apps and a desktop client share a Rust server.
audience: People using private conversations and group communities.
features: Direct messages, group chats and channels

title: Meteor
description: Firmware and diagnostic tools for an experimental ESP32-S3 platform. The project combines motion sensors, distance measurements and telemetry for hardware development.
audience: Embedded systems developers and experimental flight platform teams.

title: AI Sandbox
description: A mobile environment for creating game projects from text descriptions and presets. Combines a project library, editor, generation server and Godot-based execution.

Library and editor for 2D and 3D projects
Scene execution through a Godot host

title: PlantPal

audience: Indoor plant owners.
